title: The Tells That Funders Use to Reject AI Fundraising
actionable_recommendations: Use AI tools like ChatGPT to brainstorm and organize ideas, not as final authors.
Remove AI-generated content that feels generic before submitting grants or donor documents.
Add personal experiences and specific details to enhance authenticity.
claims_requiring_current_verification: Fundraising outcomes may vary based on a nonprofit's readiness and unique situation.
Funders do not need AI detection software to recognize AI-generated content.
major_ideas: AI tools can save time for nonprofits in fundraising.
Subtle signs of AI use can damage credibility in funding applications.
Human writing should convey confidence and personal experiences.
prerequisites: Understanding of how AI tools function in the context of fundraising.
Awareness of how specific language and formatting can impact credibility.
proposed_workflow: Utilize AI for brainstorming and organizing notes.
Draft initial ideas with AI, then edit for authenticity and personal voice.
Ensure final documents are free from common AI indicators.
tools_templates_resources: Examples of human vs AI writing styles to learn from.
